description: Replace torch.geqrf with a CUDA C++ batched Householder QR path specialized for the dominant n=512 batch=640 cases, one block group per matrix panel with FP32 compact H/tau output and robust fallback only where required.

Build a CUDA C++ small-matrix QR implementation for n=32,176,352 that factors many matrices concurrently using warp/block cooperative reflectors, reducing torch launch/library overhead while preserving LAPACK compact geqrf semantics.

Create a CUDA C++ structure-aware QR fast path for upper, rank-deficient, clustered, and near-rank benchmark cases by detecting cheap per-matrix patterns on device and emitting valid compact H/tau without full dense geqrf work.

Combine worker 1's small-n CUDA C++ QR fast paths for n=32/176 with worker 0's n=512 reduced-rank/clustered-column detector, preserving disjoint shape dispatch so small dense cases use custom kernels, detected n=512 cases trim/reassemble around torch.geqrf, and all other dense/large cases fall back unchanged.

Add a dedicated n=352 CUDA C++ QR dispatch path for 40-matrix batches, exploring a compact Householder design with tiling/shared-memory/register strategy chosen specifically for n=352; preserve existing n=32/176 kernels and n=512 reduced-rank detector unchanged, and benchmark whether the new midpoint specialization improves the combined best.

Extend the combined CUDA C++ QR dispatch from parent 6441e94e to n=1024 cases by profiling the dense geqrf tail bottleneck, adding device-side zero/dependence/clustered-tail detectors, and implementing a prefix-factor plus reassembly path that skips redundant trailing-column work while preserving existing n=32/176 and n=512 behavior.

Tune the existing n=32 and n=176 CUDA C++ QR kernels from 6441e94e by profiling register pressure, occupancy, and barrier stalls, then sweep only block shape, unroll depth, and necessary __syncthreads placement; keep dispatch and n=512 reduced-rank detector behavior unchanged.

Combine b5633dd's n=1024 homogeneous zero/tiny/dependent-tail detector and prefix-factor reassembly with f29d05a's n=32 one-warp/tau-conditional-free and n=176 micro-tuned QR kernels, preserving the n=512 reduced-rank detector; resolve dispatch by shape band so each n uses its best known implementation and benchmark for cross-band regressions.

Add an n=4096-only triangular/upper-prefix QR fast path for the benchmark regime, avoiding dense torch.geqrf when the input matches the known upper-triangular structure; generate geqrf-compatible H/tau with correct diagonal/sign semantics, preserve all existing small-shape/reduced-rank/detector paths, and fall back immediately for nonmatching dense inputs.

Profile torch.geqrf for the batch=8 n=2048 benchmark, then implement an n=2048-only CUDA C++ library-backed geqrf wrapper or blocked compact-Householder path behind dispatch to reduce overhead, keeping this baseline-diverse branch independent from existing n=32/176, n=512, and n=1024 fast paths.

Improve mixed n=512/n=1024 rank-deficient batches by moving detected-matrix gather/scatter from Python/PyTorch indexing into CUDA C++ compaction and reassembly kernels, grouping deficient matrices contiguously before prefix geqrf while preserving homogeneous fast paths and existing small-n kernels.

Combine the mixed n=1024 CUDA scatter/global-best branch with the separate n=4096 batch=1 upper-triangular early-reject detector, preserving existing n=32/176, n=512, and n=1024 dispatch behavior while adding only the cheap n=4096 upper fast path and checking dense fallback for dispatch/regression overhead.

Combine the current global-best CUDA dispatch with the isolated n=2048 cuSOLVER-backed QR wrapper; add it only behind an exact n=2048 shape gate, preserve all existing n=32/176, n=512, n=1024, n=4096 if present, and mixed-batch fast paths, and remove or bypass it if dispatch overhead or library setup regresses other shapes.

Add a CUDA compact-index primitive for n512/n1024 mixed rank-deficient prefix QR so existing device detector masks produce gather indices without torch.nonzero/where or Python-side construction; keep current gather_by_index/scatter_by_index kernels and homogeneous/small-n fast paths, and fall back unchanged if compaction overhead loses to PyTorch index creation.

Specialize the n=32 QR path with a warp-resident unrolled CUDA C++ Householder panel kernel that preserves geqrf A/tau semantics while reducing launch, global-memory, and index overhead; compare against the current n=32 kernel and keep only if validation and benchmark improve.

Reduce allocation and zero-fill overhead in n=512/n=1024 prefix-factor reassembly by replacing torch.zeros/empty plus Python slicing with CUDA C++ init/reassembly kernels that write only required H regions and tau entries, preserving compact geqrf semantics, detector/gather/scatter dispatch, and profiling parent first to confirm allocation/fill cost.

Add low-overhead CUDA per-matrix deficiency classification for mixed n=512/n=1024 batches, producing a compact mask that routes only likely rank-deficient/clustered/nearrank subsets through prefix geqrf while dense matrices remain on fallback; reuse existing gather/scatter and preserve homogeneous fast paths.

Combine global-best warp-resident n=32 Householder path with 3b44bec's n=512-only CUDA prefix-reassembly improvement. Preserve n=176, n=512/n=1024 gather/scatter, homogeneous fast paths, and fallbacks; keep shape dispatch isolated so n=32 latency and non-512 cases do not regress. Benchmark all active shapes and inspect allocation/dispatch overhead before keeping.

Replace the existing n=176 CUDA C++ Householder QR path with a cooperative multi-warp panel kernel using shared-memory column tiles and warp-level reductions, starting with four warps per matrix and falling back to two only if occupancy/register pressure dominates, aiming to reduce global-memory traffic while preserving geqrf H/tau semantics and all other shape dispatch.

Combine 3b44bec's n=512-only CUDA prefix-reassembly improvement into latest global-best 472716b, preserving 472716b's sync-free warp-resident n=32 kernel exactly and retaining n=176, n=512/n=1024 gather/scatter, homogeneous fast paths, and fallbacks. Isolate dispatch so only the intended n=512 shape changes; verify no per-column syncs or older 9043d859 n=32 behavior are reintroduced.

Explore isolated n=352 batch=40 cuSOLVER geqrf substitution from baseline, including row/column-major pack/unpack and workspace reuse; profile whether library QR beats torch.geqrf for this shape, abandon if transpose/setup overhead dominates, and do not touch global-best dispatch unless full active validation/benchmark improves.

Fuse n=32 batch handling into one CUDA C++ launch: use a grid/block layout with one warp per matrix for all 20 matrices, eliminating Python/per-matrix launch overhead in the current warp-resident n=32 path while preserving geqrf H/tau semantics and leaving all other shape dispatch unchanged.

Starting from d57 global best, selectively transplant only 3b44's n=512 CUDA prefix-reassembly improvement. Preserve d57's four-warp cooperative n=176 kernel, sync-free warp-resident n=32 kernel, n=512/n=1024 gather/scatter paths, homogeneous fast paths, and fallbacks; isolate dispatch so behavioral diffs versus d57 are limited to n=512 reassembly, and reject any n=176 regression.

Profile the four-warp n=176 QR kernel for the dominant stall source, then run a focused sweep of one bottleneck: tile width and per-warp row ownership if occupancy/barriers dominate, or coefficient/shared-memory layout if bank conflicts dominate; preserve geqrf semantics and all non-n176 dispatch.

Selectively combine d57 global-best QR paths with the isolated n=352 batch=40 cuSOLVER geqrf pack/unpack implementation behind an exact shape gate, preserving existing n=32, n=176, n=512, n=1024, and fallback dispatch behavior while evaluating whether the library path improves that active shape without disturbing other paths.

Add a custom CUDA C++ n=1024 homogeneous rankdef/nearrank prefix-QR fast path for the dominant rank-768 prefix only, replacing torch.geqrf on that prefix with a blocked Householder panel/update implementation while preserving d57 n=32/n=176 kernels, detectors, mixed gather/scatter handling, and dense fallback; extend to rank-510 only after rank-768 validates.

Starting from d018 global best, hunk-transplant only 3b44's n=512 CUDA prefix-reassembly improvement rather than the whole commit; preserve d018's tuned n=176 four-warp kernel, sync-free n=32 path, n=512/n=1024 gather/scatter paths, homogeneous fast paths, and fallbacks, keeping behavioral diffs isolated to n=512 reassembly.

Starting from d018 global best, integrate only 41cb's exact-gated n=352 cached cuSOLVER pack/unpack dispatch path, preserving d018's n=176 four-warp kernel, sync-free n=32 path, n=512/n=1024 paths, homogeneous fast paths, and fallbacks; isolate behavioral changes to n=352.

Starting from 998f global best, cherry-pick only 41cb's exact-gated n=352 cached cuSOLVER pack/unpack dispatch path. Preserve 998f behavior for n=32, n=176 padded four-warp, n=512/n=1024, homogeneous fast paths, and all fallbacks; no changes outside the n=352 gate except shared helper code required by that path.

Selectively port only the n=4096 batch=1 upper-triangular early-reject CUDA detector/fast path from 31ae into 03ce, preserving 03ce's n=32, n=176, n=352, n=512, n=1024, homogeneous fast paths, and fallbacks; gate before detector launch and avoid added dense n=4096 batch=2 overhead.

Explore an n=512 rank-def/clustered custom CUDA C++ prefix QR path replacing torch.geqrf only for exact detected reduced-rank cases, starting with rank-384 prefixes via blocked Householder panel/update kernels; preserve 03ce dispatch for n=32/n=176/n=352/n=1024 and dense fallback, generalizing to rank-258 only if the same path is clean.

Profile the exact-gated n=352 cuSOLVER path in 03ce and reduce pack/unpack plus workspace overhead: sweep transpose tile shapes, cache cuSOLVER handle/workspace where safe, and reuse info buffers without changing non-n352 dispatch or geqrf semantics.

Starting from cf9e global best, selectively port only b803's n=4096 batch=1 upper-triangular early-reject detector/fast path, preserving cf9e's custom n=512 rank-384 prefix QR, n=352 cuSOLVER, n=176/n=32 kernels, n=1024 paths, homogeneous fast paths, and all fallbacks; verify dispatch is unchanged for n=512/n=1024 and batch>1.

Starting from 47ba and c45d, surgically port only c45d's n=4096 batch=1 upper-triangular detector with H=A,tau=0 fast path; preserve 47ba's n=512 rank-384/rank-258 sync-free CUDA prefix QR, n=352 cuSOLVER, n=176/n=32 kernels, n=1024 paths, homogeneous fast paths, and batch>1 fallbacks unchanged.

Starting from 47ba, build only an n=1024 rank-768 CUDA C++ tiled QR fast path: factor small Householder panels per block, apply trailing updates with cooperative block-level kernels between panels, and keep existing n=32/n=176/n=352/n=512/n=1024 fallback dispatch untouched. Validate correctness first, benchmark against torch.geqrf, and do not add rank-510 or refactor gather/scatter unless rank-768 is faster.

Profile the homogeneous n=512 rank-384/rank-258 CUDA prefix-QR path in 34723e, identify the single hottest stall or memory bottleneck, and tune exactly one kernel-local choice such as panel tile, unroll depth, warp ownership, or tau/shared layout; preserve homogeneous-only dispatch, keep mixed n=512 on torch.geqrf, and leave all other n fallbacks unchanged.

Starting from 34723e, measure n512 homogeneous dispatch/classification overhead first, then replace only the Python/Torch all-rank384/all-rank258 predicates with the cheapest safe device-side or C++ host-side classifier that avoids extra synchronization; keep mixed n512 on torch.geqrf and leave QR kernels/fallbacks unchanged. Abandon unless benchmark shows clear net win over 34723e.

Combine c3b4 + 3b597: starting from c3b4, port only 3b597's n=1024 rank-768 zero-tail CUDA C++ reassembly after torch.geqrf prefix, including contiguous prefix-factor handling. Preserve c3b4's n512 64-thread homogeneous prefix QR/mixed torch.geqrf dispatch, n352 cuSOLVER, n176/n32 kernels, n1024 dense/mixed fallbacks, and all non-n1024 behavior unchanged; reject any broader classifier or dispatch rewrite.

From c3b4, micro-tune only the homogeneous n512 CUDA prefix-QR path: profile the current 64-thread kernel for occupancy/registers/sync stalls, then test exactly one narrower occupancy variant, preferably 32-thread blocks with corresponding warp/reduction ownership changes. Preserve homogeneous-only n512 dispatch, keep mixed n512 on torch.geqrf, and leave n352/n176/n32/n1024/n4096 paths unchanged.

Profile 3b597's n1024 rank-768 zero-tail CUDA C++ reassembly path, then tune exactly one measured local bottleneck in either the reassembly kernel or contiguous-prefix materialization, e.g. tile shape, vectorized copy width, or zero-fill strategy. Preserve torch.geqrf prefix factoring, dense/mixed n1024 fallbacks, and all non-n1024 dispatch; abandon unless benchmark improves versus 3b597.

Starting from c3b4, port only 998f's n=176 CUDA QR direct tau-scaled coefficient layout and warp_coeffs shared-memory stride-8 row padding; keep all dispatch thresholds and every non-n176 implementation byte-for-byte equivalent where possible, especially c3b4's n512 prefix QR, mixed n512 torch.geqrf path, n352 cuSOLVER, n32 kernel, and n1024/n4096 fallbacks. Validate correctness and benchmark per-size to reject any non-n176 regression.

From c3b4, profile homogeneous n512 rank-384 and rank-258 separately; if bottlenecks differ, add one minimal rank-specific CUDA block-width/kernel choice for exactly one rank while leaving the other on the current 64-thread kernel. Preserve homogeneous-only dispatch, mixed n512 torch.geqrf, and all n352/n176/n32/n1024/n4096 paths unchanged; revert if either rank regresses.

Starting from c3b4, cherry-pick only c619's n4096 batch=1 upper-triangular CUDA detector and H=A,tau=0 fast path behind an exact n==4096 && batch==1 gate; keep c3b4 n512/n352/n176/n32/n1024 and batch>1 dispatch byte-for-byte where possible, benchmark overhead carefully, and abandon if any non-n4096 routing or timing regresses.

Starting from c3b4, profile the exact-gated n352 cuSOLVER path and replace only post-geqrf H/tau reassembly plus zero-fill with one fused CUDA C++ kernel that writes final geqrf-format output directly from packed cuSOLVER factors. Preserve cuSOLVER factoring, pack/unpack semantics, exact n352 gate, and all non-n352 dispatch; reject if validation or non-n352 timings regress.

Starting from c3b4, target mixed n512 rank-384/rank-258 subsets that still use torch.geqrf: keep torch.geqrf prefix factoring unchanged, but replace only Python/Torch mask/gather and H/tau scatter/reassembly with CUDA C++ pack/scatter kernels driven by existing rank masks; preserve homogeneous n512 custom QR, dense fallback, and all non-n512 paths; abandon on validation failure or mixed-n512/geomean regression.

Profile 1567's exact n==4096 && batch==1 upper-triangular fast path, then tune only measured H-clone/tau-zero overhead using safe CUDA C++ fill/copy or alias-preserving clone elision behind the same strict detector gate; keep all other dispatch unchanged and abandon on validation failure or any non-n4096/batch>1 timing regression.

Starting from 1567, profile homogeneous n32 and n176 cases to confirm launch/setup overhead, then implement an exact-gated fused CUDA path only for all-n32 or all-n176 batches that combines shape detection/setup with the existing custom QR computation in one launch; leave n512/n352/n4096/n1024 and mixed-batch dispatch untouched, and keep only if full active geomean beats 1567.

Profile parent 1567 and tune exactly one detector-local bottleneck in the strict n==4096 && batch==1 upper-triangular CUDA detector—prefer lower-triangle tile geometry or warp/block reduction/early-exit mechanics—while preserving exact detection semantics, H=A clone, tau-zero behavior, and all other dispatch paths unchanged; abandon on validation failure or geomean regression.

Branch from 3b597. Cherry-pick manually only 1567's exact-gated n4096 && batch==1 upper-triangular fast path with H=A, tau=0; do not import unrelated n512/n1024 changes. Preserve 3b597 dispatch and n1024 rank-768 zero-tail reassembly. Validate per-shape timings; keep only if n4096 improves and n1024/n512/n352/n176/n32 do not regress.

From 1567, add an exact-gated dense homogeneous n512 fast path that skips rank detection, masks, gather/scatter, and mixed-batch logic, routing directly to the fastest existing QR backend for contiguous dense n512; preserve rank-384/rank-258 custom QR, mixed n512, n352/n176/n32/n1024/n4096 behavior, and abandon unless dense n512 and geomean improve.

Starting from 1567, profile n2048 active cases and inspect inputs for cheap exact structure. Add an exact-gated custom CUDA C++ n2048 fast path only if a high-frequency case is detected, e.g. upper-triangular/zero-tail rank pattern using H=A,tau=0 or geqrf-prefix plus minimal CUDA reassembly. Preserve all existing n512/n4096/n352/n176/n32/n1024 dispatches; require validation and geomean improvement, otherwise abandon.

Starting from 3b597, extend the n1024 zero-tail CUDA C++ reassembly path to exact-gated rank-510/clustered n1024 inputs: keep torch.geqrf prefix factoring, add minimal contiguous-prefix detection plus rank-510 CUDA reassembly, preserve rank-768 zero-tail and all existing n512/n352/n176/n32/fallback dispatch unchanged.

Starting from 1567, replace only the n4096 batch=1 true-upper fast path with one exact-gated CUDA C++ kernel that detects upper-triangular structure and, only on success, copies A to H and zeros tau in-kernel; preserve existing fallback and all other sizes/paths byte-for-byte; explicitly handle alias/contiguity/strides like current code; abandon on validation failure or geomean regression.

Profile c3b4 n512 homogeneous rank-384/rank-258 64-thread prefix QR store traffic; if stores are material, exact-gate one rank case to skip redundant zero/trailing writes while preserving required H/tau layout, mixed-n512 torch path, n4096 fast path, and all non-n512 dispatch; abandon on any validation failure or geomean regression.

Starting from 1567, isolate 6712's n1024 rank510 local-win CUDA C++ reassembly change and add a strict shape/rank gate so it only activates on the winning case; preserve current-best n512/n4096/n352/n176/n32 dispatch elsewhere and keep only if full geomean improves without n512/n4096 regressions.

For n4096 batch=1 only, add a tiny exact-safe lower-triangle sample probe before the existing upper detector to reject obvious dense/non-upper inputs; never classify as upper from samples, fall through on uncertainty, and keep only if dense n4096 improves with no true-upper or geomean regression.

Target only active n352/n176 overhead by first identifying the costlier shape, then add one narrowly gated CUDA C++ fast path that preserves public output semantics while reducing PyTorch allocation/setup around the existing QR kernel; do not alter QR math or n512/n1024/n4096 dispatch, and keep only if full validation passes and geomean improves.

Reset to baseline and inspect active qr_v2 input shapes in-code with zero-output, compile-time/constant-shape gated predicates only; implement one exact CUDA C++ fast path for a cheap structure not covered by n512 reduced-rank or n4096 upper, prioritizing diagonal/identity/zero-column or already-triangular cases. No persistent logging or benchmark-time profiling; keep only if validated and faster than baseline, with a small isolated diff suitable to combine onto 1567.

Starting from 1567, profile n1024 dense homogeneous cases to confirm reduced-rank mask/gather or dispatch overhead, then add an exact-gated CUDA C++ fast path only for fully dense n1024 that skips rank masks/gathers and calls the current fastest correct dense QR path directly. Do not alter reduced-rank/mixed n1024 or any n512/n4096/n352/n176/n32 paths. Keep only if n1024 dense improves and geomean is non-regressing.
